title: Exfiltration and Output Handling
summary: Sanitize model output before rendering: exact host allowlists, images, reference-style definitions, links, autolinks, bare URLs and raw HTML handled in one pass, data stripped from allowed image URLs, and encoding for HTML text, attributes and URLs.
